changes: Stopped unavailable routes and target loss select another checked approach with new observations
Partial navigation and failed camera baselines invalidate old frames
Measured lidar rays clear stale occupancy only in currently observed free space; concurrent hits win
Search proposals account for observation and turning cost instead of preferring zero-gain rotations
Known exhausted-search and exhausted-approach causes produce bounded executor proposals
Each proposal is compared with the same ACT on ten identical physical scenes; any scene regression or collision rejects it
Promoted executor recipe is bound to the same profile for simulation, corrective demonstrations, final qualification and Jetson execution
Only an untouched waiting room owner can be upgraded; same cycle ID, old source/state backed up, current ACT untouched
unchanged: Physical geometry, materials and collision guards
Semantic confidence and temporal observation thresholds
Full-mission success and independent physical outcome scoring
Two disjoint final groups of ten scenes, separated from all training scenes
All prior attempts, failures, checkpoints and datasets
unknown_source_defects: Agent follow-up must diagnose and test a concrete fix; the program cannot rewrite arbitrary unknown source defects
